statement.document_title: Hot take on OpenAI’s new GPT-4o

our_interpretation: The claim concerns OpenAI's position on May 13, 2024.
The plain reading of 'have' is possession of a completed GPT-5 model, including internally. Public non-release alone does not establish this.
Fourteen months refers approximately to the interval since GPT-4's announcement. It does not establish when GPT-5 development began or whether work continued throughout that interval.
criteria.support_condition: Reliable dated development records or disclosures establish that OpenAI lacked a completed GPT-5 on May 13, 2024, despite attempting to develop its successor over approximately the stated interval.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Reliable records establish that a completed GPT-5 existed by May 13, 2024, or establish a development chronology incompatible with the claimed duration.
